parsed.explanation: Combined national-state regime imposes birth-sex facilities bans, birth-sex custody placement, and visa/passport discrepancy screening with refusal and possible fraud consequences. Visitor faces universal exposure in government facilities, documented arrest and 24-hour men's-ward holding, and severe immigration-custody abuse if detained. No execution or routine long imprisonment, and courts, national hate-crime/employment protections and three city ordinances offer partial recourse, but no documented effective remedy in this state. State-threat framing and lack of state protections drive risk below mid-scale.

entry_documents.exposure: National binary-sex passport policy, visa cable instructs refusal where documents/records cast reasonable doubt on sex, and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility for wilful misrepresentation. Passports confiscated/blocked reported.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports remain valid until expiry; fraud finding requires four elements, is never automatic, limited waivers exist; civil-liberties suit pending.
entry_documents.interaction: Home-passport mismatch can trigger entry refusal/stranding before any local facility or custody exposure, and refusal record may affect future travel.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections policy from 2026 mandates conversion-therapy practices, cutting hair, removing hormones; immigration custody reports forced labour, beatings, solitary, severe sexual abuse. Arrestee held 24h in men's ward.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Trespass arrest requires willful entry plus refusal to depart; maximum 60 days in documented arrest case; legal aid and courts exist nationally.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Document/facility encounter can escalate to detention, then birth-sex placement and hormone denial, compounding humiliation and abuse risk.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: State Act effective 1 July 2025 reserves multi-occupancy restrooms, changing areas, sleeping quarters by biological sex in public facilities, with private cause of action. National ban on government-funded facilities matching identity.
federal_state_facilities.protection: No state public-accommodations protection; three cities have local ordinances. Ten of mapped state/provinces ban in all government buildings; this state is among them.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Universal, unavoidable exposure for any trans visitor using public restrooms/locker rooms; private cause of action adds complainant-driven enforcement.

care_services.exposure: National orders target gender-affirming care for minors and proposed insurance bar under 18; custodial hormone removal documented. State bans care for minors effective 1 July 2024.
care_services.protection: Adult routine care not documented as banned; emergency care not documented as denied. National challenges to several orders are pending/enjoined in part.
care_services.interaction: Adult dependent on hormones risks interruption in detention, delay or denial if outed; medication confiscation is not documented for ordinary visitors.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National guidance frames 'radical gender ideology' among violent extremist views; 2026 strategy prioritizes 'radically pro-transgender' groups. State rated Negative band, listed among worst for anti-trans legislation.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; employment discrimination prohibited under 2020 Supreme Court ruling nationwide.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat-framing increases police/officer discretion risk and legitimizes birth-sex enforcement across facilities, schools, custody.

minors_guardians.exposure: School law requires pre-K+ students to use restrooms aligned with sex assigned at birth; sports ban; minor care ban. National order directs investigation/prosecution over teachers facilitating social transition.
minors_guardians.protection: Districts must provide reasonable accommodation for students not wishing to use birth-sex multi-occupancy restroom/locker room.
minors_guardians.interaction: Travelling minor faces outing, segregated facilities, care/sports exclusion; parent/guardian and school staff face investigation risk if accommodating identity.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No state hate-crime statute; 2025 poll shows 66% support birth-sex document laws, indicating majoritarian hostility. Documented handcuffed arrest in capitol restroom.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National 2009 hate-crime law covers gender identity; three cities prohibit discrimination in employment, housing, public accommodations.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: In most of state, victim has only national recourse and no state bias-crime/anti-discrimination enforcement; police are enforcers of facility ban, not documented protectors.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Remedies are slow, contested, and state facilities law challenge/enforcement suits not documented; no state protections to invoke.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Passport suit, challenges to executive orders, national courts and legal-aid FAQ documented; several orders blocked/enjoined, outcomes unresolved.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Unresolved litigation means visitor cannot predict whether national or state restrictions will be in effect at travel time; no documented remedy that reliably overturns field decisions.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: routine police identity checks, detention/humiliation without routine long imprisonment, courts defer or remedies slow. Here exposure is codified facility ban and visa screening rather than unwritten police instruction, but practical outcome similar.

Similar tier-1 element: birth-sex custody/ward placement with documented harm and minor sentences, no execution. This case is slightly higher because trespass requires refusal to depart, max 60 days documented, and functioning national courts/challenges exist, unlike unremedied prison placement.

Higher risk than 0.55-C: that anchor has ward-by-marker delay with ethics/advocate remedies working faster for emergencies. Here government facility exclusion is criminalized in some circumstances, arrest and men's-ward holding are documented, and no working state remedy is documented.

Much lower than 0.75-C: that anchor has respectful border training, tribunal appeal, counsel and compensation for unlawful holding. Here national cable directs refusal on doubt and this state has no gender-identity public-accommodations protection.

parsed.synthesis: Interaction is cumulative: visa/document doubt can refuse entry; if admitted, birth-sex facilities ban applies universally and can trigger trespass arrest; arrest leads to birth-sex ward holding; detention risks hormone removal and documented custodial abuse. National hate-crime/employment law, city ordinances and pending court challenges are protections, but they do not preempt federal screening, state facility enforcement, or birth-sex custody, and none is documented as operating effectively for a short-stay visitor in this state. For a minor, school, sports and care bans add age-specific exposure for child and guardian. No capital or routine long imprisonment keeps score above severe tier.
